snippet.title: Unchained League Character Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Unchained League is a series of playable stories from the children's library. You get to play as your favorite heroes from different storybooks.

The game is currently being developed in Ghana. Try out the tech demo on our website at https://unchainedleague.com/try-the-mvp

For more info, visit https://unchainedleague.com/

If you believe in this project, consider becoming a supporter on Patreon at https://www.patreon.com/unchaineduniverse

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
